script:

mkdir -p "$NVM_DIR"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm/archive/refs/tags/${NVM_VERSION}.tar.gz" | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$NVM_DIR"
cat > /etc/profile.d/nvm.sh <<'NVM_PROFILE'
export NVM_DIR=/opt/nvm
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
NVM_PROFILE
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/nvm.sh

name: VSCodium

script:
ASSET="$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/VSCodium/vscodium/releases/latest | python3 -c 'import json,sys,platform; a=platform.machine(); d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(next((x["browser_download_url"] for x in d["assets"] if x["name"].endswith("." + a + ".rpm")), ""))')"
[ -n "$ASSET" ] || { echo "No VSCodium RPM for $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1; }
RPM_FILE=/tmp/vscodium.rpm
curl -fL "$ASSET" -o "$RPM_FILE"
zypper --non-interactive --gpg-auto-import-keys install --allow-unsigned-rpm --auto-agree-with-licenses "$RPM_FILE"
